title: Gene Therapy for Painful Diabetic Neuropathy
brief_summary: The purpose of this open label, Phase I/II, dose-escalation, 3-cohort, multicenter, 12-month study, is to assess the safety and tolerability of injecting Engensis (VM202) in the leg muscle in patients with painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN). The study will also assess the potential of VM202 to reduce the pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy.
